change.summary: gguf_norm_fixed5120_wave256_kernel gains a kRoundSum template parameter, the add+rmsnorm layer gets a rounded_bf16_out_fixed5120_wave256 variant of it, and gfx1100 declares GGUF_ROUNDED_NORM_RESIDUAL_DECODE_POLICIES for (rows, 5120) with 2 <= rows <= 8. The generic gguf_rounded_add_rmsnorm_bf16_f32_weight_kernel was one block per row already but had a runtime-trip-count loop with no register cache, so it read the residual and the addend twice and paid the nine-barrier tree.
change.arithmetic_neutral_basis: One block owns one row, so blockIdx.x only selects the row base. The rounded leaf caches the same 20 per-thread bf16(bf16(x)+bf16(add)) values the generic owner recomputes in its second pass, and reproduces the generic 256-thread reduction tree level for level.

bit_identity.method: New leaf vs generic gguf_rounded_add_rmsnorm_bf16_f32_weight on real bf16 tensors at hidden_size 5120, rows 2/3/4/5/6/8; norm_out and residual_out compared elementwise. The same test asserts the rounded residual differs from the exact f32 sum, so the round-trip is exercised.

microbenchmark.protocol: 400 launches per measurement, min of 7 rounds, real IQ4_XS tensor bytes

verifier_census_ab.note: The two arms' bands do not overlap. The family delta (-7.469 ms over 12 steps) is larger than the whole-step delta (-5.27 ms over 12 steps), the expected direction when a sub-window win is partly absorbed by run-to-run spread elsewhere. A separate baseline run with the switch set and the final resolver code confirmed the trace carries the generic kernel name (945 calls, 13.38 us, 12.640 ms).

numerics_gate.note: Identical to the last digit to the parent commit's run (results/2026-09-13-ud-gfx1100-norm-fixed5120-row-slab.json). That is the predicted outcome of the bit-identity proof, and it is the direct end-to-end confirmation that the substitution is numerically invisible.

paired_suite.binding_gates: all four arms binding_passed=True timing_evidence_valid=True; both UD arms complete_exact 0/20 divergent
paired_suite.note: The flat true-AR denominator is the confirmation: the rounded leaf's envelope starts at rows 2, so a verifier-only change must not move the single-row rate.

incident.first_attempt: The variant was registered without making the new wrapper _prevalidated-aware. The profiled child died with TypeError: gguf_rounded_add_rmsnorm_bf16_f32_weight_fixed5120_wave256() got an unexpected keyword argument '_prevalidated'.
incident.resolution: Every kernel reached through _gguf_norm_residual_decode_kernel is invoked with _prevalidated=True, so the new wrapper honours it like its fixed-5120 siblings.
